effects: Sets the signer's stETH allowance for _spender to exactly _amount, replacing any earlier allowance (StETH._approve: allowances[_owner][_spender] = _amount).
An allowance of type(uint256).max is never used up when the spender spends from it (StETH._spendAllowance).
formats.shown: Approve stETH: 'Allow to spend 0.24 stETH', with the Spender address and the Amount shown as stETH, or 'Unlimited' at or above 2^255.

findings.title: approve: interpolatedIntent leaves out the spender, so 'Allow to spend' has no subject.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json approve interpolatedIntent "Allow to spend {_amount}"; #._spender is an always-visible field. Case 0 screen: 'Allow to spend 0.24 stETH'.

findings.title: approve: Spender addressName types allow only 'contract', but the code accepts any address.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json approve field Spender params.types ["contract"]; StETH._approve only requires _spender != address(0).
findings.fix: Set types to ["contract","eoa","wallet"] and add "ens" to sources.

cases.notes: The approval of 0.24 stETH to 0x40aa…cd7f appears in the fields, and the reader understood it. The reader was unsure who the spender is.

effects: Sends msg.value ETH from the signer to the Lido contract. The call reverts if the value is zero or above the stake limit.
Mints stETH shares to the signer, getSharesByPooledEth(msg.value), worth about msg.value stETH (1 wei less in case 1 from rounding).
The _referral address is only emitted in the Submitted event and moves none of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Stake ETH: 'Stake 1.078608424000534547 ETH', with the ETH amount shown and the referral hidden.

findings.title: submit: the screen never says the signer receives stETH in return for the ETH.
findings.evidence: Lido._submit: _mintShares(msg.sender, sharesAmount); _emitTransferAfterMintingShares(msg.sender, sharesAmount). Case 1 mined: stETH transfer in of 1078608424000534546 to the signer. Screen intent 'Stake ETH' / 'Stake {@.value}' says nothing about stETH. The reader wrote 'Screen doesn't say; normally stETH would arrive'.
findings.fix: Use the intent "Stake ETH for stETH" and the interpolatedIntent "Stake {@.value} and receive stETH".

findings.title: submit: stETH minted comes from the share rate in storage and can be 1 wei below the ETH sent.
findings.evidence: Lido._submit: sharesAmount = getSharesByPooledEth(msg.value). Case 1: 1078608424000534547 ETH out, 1078608424000534546 stETH in.
findings.fix: None needed. The rate is read from storage and no descriptor field can show it.

cases.notes: The ETH sent is shown exactly. The stETH received is not on the screen; the reader only guessed it from the word 'Stake'.

effects: Moves the shares worth _amount stETH, getSharesByPooledEth(_amount), from the signer to _recipient. The recipient's balance can be 1-2 wei below _amount from share rounding.
The call reverts if _recipient is the zero address or the stETH contract, or if the signer's shares are too few.
formats.shown: Transfer stETH: 'Send 1.012662265408189746 stETH to 0x6242…dc9f', with the Recipient and the Amount in stETH.

findings.title: transfer: Recipient types exclude 'contract', but any address except stETH itself can receive.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transfer field Recipient params.types ["eoa","wallet"]; StETH._transferShares only rejects address(0) and address(this).

findings.title: transfer: stETH moves shares, so the recipient may get 1-2 wei less than the amount shown.
findings.evidence: StETH._transfer: _sharesToTransfer = getSharesByPooledEth(_amount); _transferShares(...). The Transfer event emits _amount.
findings.fix: None. The rounding depends on the share rate in storage.

cases.notes: The stETH out matches the screen in amount and recipient.
